# Wharf 0.14.0 plan

1. Add status, notification, graceful-stop, and ephemeral-cleanup contracts.
2. Implement non-mutating status aggregation with lifecycle counts, retries,
   occupancy, and ETA.
3. Implement bounded graceful stop and targeted cleanup.
4. Implement durable file notifications and optional HTTPS webhook delivery.
5. Add status immutability, timeout cleanup, and notification tests.
6. Update repository memory and closeout records, then run formatting, build,
   tests, and diff checks before release.
